system_thesis_interpretation: V4 is a deliberately non-learned, non-rendered CPU specification instrument that preserves Dream-LoRA-Think only as an inactive future thesis: later-outcome-grounded local claims, deterministic compilation, identical text/graph/LoRA content, bounded goal-conditioned reconstruction, held-out actions, an explicit graph primary baseline, and LoRA credited only for transport or access. The active v4 question is much narrower: whether one pure exhaustive implementation conforms to a finite symbolic alignment, information, twin, cost, and bridge-deletion algebra. LOCAL is target-local information rather than an atoms baseline; MOTIF_SCHEMA directly receives the complete persistent source graph rather than learning schema; and the values 1/4 and 1, the twin, costs, deletion result, golden report, and external audit grant no benchmark, model, paper, promotion, or scientific authority. No model/provider/tokenizer, renderer/RNG/world, source life/target agent, DREAM/SLEEP/reader/memory, LoRA/weight, GPU/remote, promotion, benchmark, or claim mechanism is part of this change or may receive its outputs.
graph_delta_interpretation: Read as a standalone intended runtime declaration, the v4 arrays contain exactly five unique nodes and nine unique one-way edges. The nodes are fail-closed authority, closed domain enumerator, four isolated projections housed in one graph node, twin/cost/bridge-deletion checker, and terminal golden validator. All nine endpoints are in that set, and a topological order is authority; enumerator; projections and checker; validator. Authority sends only verified immutable constants, the enumerator sends canonical domain members to projections/checker and fixed aggregates toward validation, projections and checker declassify only golden-declared aggregates, and the validator has no outgoing graph edge. SK10 and human governance are external stages, not runtime graph nodes. The graph descriptions forbid undeclared ingress, egress, feedback, shared mutable state, filesystem/environment/cache channels in computation, network, subprocess, RNG/renderer, life or action execution, model/tokenizer/memory/LoRA/GPU, promotion, benchmark, claim, path, host, traceback, or free-form endpoints. Field-level projection isolation is coherent: LOCAL gets cal and goal; MOTIF gets graph, compatible cal, and goal; RANDOM gets two validated source graphs, target cal, and goal but cannot condition target counts on the sources; ORACLE gets pi and goal; no projection receives another projection's inputs, chosen pair, support table, or object references. However, this standalone five-node reading is not an exact successor delta from v3 as written. V4 marks all five nodes and all nine edges as add, even though SKN01_AUTHORITY and all SKE01-SKE09 identifiers already exist in the v3 architecture, and it neither removes nor modifies the renamed v3 enumerator, projection, checker, validator, edges, or SKL01 loop. Literal delta application therefore collides on identifiers and leaves stale v3 nodes and loop rather than yielding only five nodes and two loops; this is blocking disagreement D01.
loop_delta_interpretation: The intended two-stage lifecycle is appropriately fail-closed. SKL01 permits only read-only creation of at least two fresh exact interpretations, adversarial critique, concern-by-concern adjudicated consensus, and a separate human-authored ratification bound to exact bytes and exact requested and forbidden scopes. It creates no implementation, test, execution, receipt, evidence, compute result, promotion, or claim. Only a releasable consensus followed by Rohin Ghosh's separate exact ratification can trigger SKL02. After that approval, SKL02 may perform only the three requested scope atoms: exhaustive pure CPU conformance, unit/property tests and exact successful golden output, plus an external post-freeze scope audit for human review. Any invariant or implementation failure emits no successful report and exits nonzero. SK10 is not mounted, imported, summarized, or received by any runtime node; neither report nor audit is successor scientific input. This repairs v3's preapproval governance deadlock and removes the v3 audit-ingress contradiction, but it does not repair the predecessor-loop lineage problem caused by adding SKL01/SKL02 without removing or modifying v3 SKL01_EXACT_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL.
claim_delta_interpretation: All six v4 claim entries are non-headline and non-transitive. C01 permits only implementation-conformance wording after exact SK01-SK09 bytes, external SK10, fresh review, and separate claim-specific authority. C02 limits 1/4 versus 1 to the closed symbolic information geometry and expressly denies learned schema induction. C03 limits the twin and BRIDGE result to a non-automorphic, cost-preserving symbolic counterfactual and exact deletion necessity; substitution, learned composition, environment shortest paths, and development are absent. C04-C06 retire any atoms/baseline, learned-system/paper, or report/audit-as-scientific-evidence reading. This is consistent with the exact eight forbidden scope atoms and creates no renderer, life, model, memory, LoRA, GPU, promotion, benchmark, or claim ingress. The changed claim identifiers do not clearly map to the predecessor claim registry, so their operation=modify/retire semantics inherit the broader successor-delta ambiguity in D01, but the substantive v4 claim firewall itself does not expand authority.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is structurally the exact Cartesian product advertised: 120 unique information items times ten unique stages equals 1,200 unique cells, with no duplicate, missing, or extra information/stage pair. The ten stages are authority, enumerator, four capability-separated projection principals, checker, terminal validator, external SK10 auditor, and human governance review. Counts by stage are internally consistent with the field rules: authority sees 30 and hides per-case values; enumerator sees the 20 non-golden contract constants and its six fields and derives only legal projection arguments; each projection sees only its own 7/8/9/7 input-output fields plus the public non-golden constants and only the enumerator fields necessary to compute them; checker sees its 15 fields plus six derived enumerator fields; validator sees only two golden constants and 31 fixed report fields; SK10 sees authority/scope bindings, 20 non-golden contract constants, and seven audit fields while report and symbolic case fields are hidden or forbidden; human review sees authority, all 22 contract fields, 31 report fields, and seven audit fields while per-case witnesses remain hidden or forbidden. Golden bytes are forbidden to enumerator, projections, checker, and SK10. Report and audit are separate terminal evidence boundaries. This closes runtime field-level answer flow, but the declared 120-item universe omits the frozen implementation source bytes, repository-diff base and entries, per-file hashes or manifest root, dependency/CLI closure inputs, and the reviewer interpretation artifact that SK10 must inspect or bind. Thus the 1,200-cell product is syntactically complete relative to its declared items but not semantically complete for the external audit stage; D03 is blocking unless those external audit inputs are explicitly bound outside this matrix by an equally exact contract.
acceptance_test_interpretation: The registry contains exactly ten unique tests. SK01-SK02 close the combinatorics: 4!*2!*2!=96 alignments, 48 first-occurrence graphs, four triples per graph, six calibration classes of 16. SK03 checks all 12 calibration-goal supports, each with four pairs at count four, exact integer source factorization, and value 1/4. SK04 checks all 96 legal graph/compatible-cal/goal tuples at value 1. SK05 checks 96 involutive twins, all four graph triples and both top actions changing, with zero failures. SK06 checks 192 intermediate cases at cost 5, 192 top cases at 8, CONJ 16, and BRIDGE 17. SK07 checks 96^2*2*2=36,864 namespace-tagged bridge cases and exactly twice that, 73,728, old/new single-product deletions; every deletion disables final craft and leaves less than the eight-action recreation cost, and no substitution claim remains. SK08 exhausts the exact legal domains LOCAL 6*2=12, MOTIF 48*2=96, RANDOM 48*48*6*2=27,648, and ORACLE 96*2=192; validates immutable reduced rational results, complete sorted support, global-index tie-breaks, isolation, and DomainError before computation for every out-of-domain call. SK09 binds one 1,476-byte successful object with SHA-256 f14fbf5de43926b19ad8c19dc71a5d0d6a8fcc37ffbe310b60d4d8d0475c6b51, lexicographically ordered JCS object members plus exactly one terminal LF, nine ordered SK01-SK09 pass receipts, and verdict RETAIN_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL. It mechanically rejects exactly six mutations: missing protocol_id, added debug, wrong protocol_id, unreduced random value 2/8, swapped first two receipts, and one extra LF. No alternate success or runtime failure report exists. SK10 is correctly absent from the golden receipts and positioned as external post-implementation review only. Its intended checks are narrow, but the exact seven-key audit object contains change_sha256 and reviewer_interpretation_sha256 without an implementation hash, per-file digest, or manifest root, so it cannot by itself satisfy its own setup and expected language that the exact implementation hashes match; it also leaves the repository-diff base, reviewer-artifact schema/location, and exact static forbidden-match/closure procedure unbound. Consequently SK01-SK09 are exact specifications, while SK10 and the claim that every v3 blocker is repaired remain underdetermined. The required_before labels are safety prerequisites only and authorize no GPU run or scientific claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the current graph_delta and loop_delta bytes unambiguously define an exact five-node, nine-edge successor to v3.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: V3 already added SKN01_AUTHORITY and SKE01-SKE09 and left SKN02_ALIGNMENT_ENUMERATOR, SKN03_REGIME_POSTERIOR_PROJECTIONS, SKN04_TWIN_COST_BRIDGE_CHECKER, SKN05_REPORT_VALIDATOR, and SKL01_EXACT_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL active. V4 marks SKN01 and every reused SKE identifier add, introduces renamed nodes and two added loops, and removes or modifies none of those predecessor entries. Literal application causes duplicate identifiers and retains stale principals/loop; treating the arrays as a replacement snapshot is not stated in the bound contract.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Issue new hash-bound bytes that either declare explicit whole-snapshot replacement semantics or express exact predecessor operations: modify/reuse the intended active IDs, remove every renamed/stale v3 node, edge, and loop, and provide an unambiguous final active registry of exactly five nodes, nine edges, and the intended two loops. Repeat deliberation; infer no repair and grant no implementation authority meanwhile.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the seven-key scope_audit.json contract repairs v3 R05 or can satisfy SK10's own requirement that exact implementation hashes match.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The exact keys include change_sha256 but no implementation digest, file-digest map, manifest root, audited commit/tree hash, or deterministic mapping from tracked_files to bytes. reviewer_interpretation_sha256 only hashes an otherwise unspecified artifact and cannot substitute for an exact source binding without a bound schema, path, and required implementation manifest fields. Subset checks also permit a list that does not establish equality with the actual changed implementation tree.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep SK10 external and non-ingress, but bind a strict external audit schema containing the audited repository/root and freeze identity, deterministic path inclusion/exclusion and ordering, per-file SHA-256 values and a manifest/root digest, exact diff-base relation, the exact implementation hash expected by the review, and a separately bound fresh-review artifact schema. Human review may compare this receipt with the terminal report, but neither may become runtime or successor scientific input.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the complete 120-by-10 Cartesian product is a complete field-level capability contract for every named stage.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The product is mechanically exact over its 120 declared items, and runtime projection/report isolation is strong. But the SK10 column names no frozen source bytes, paths plus hashes, repository diff, dependency graph, CLI source, forbidden-pattern registry, or reviewer interpretation input even though SK10 must derive its seven outputs from those objects. An external stage still needs an explicit external input boundary; omission makes information flow and audit reproducibility implementer-selected.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add the exact external audit input objects to the visibility contract or bind a separate strict external-audit visibility artifact. Make them visible only to SK10 and the human governance reviewer, forbidden to all five runtime nodes, and permanently barred from later scientific ingress. Recompute the exact Cartesian product and re-deliberate the new change hash.
